# H06 evidence / Протокол H06

Review required; no automatic HW VERIFIED promotion.

## Review summary

The corrected H06 timer subgroup **PASS (HW OBSERVED)** on firmware
1.04-1.04. With KEL103 CR 22 Ω connected sequentially, all three 3.0 s
timers switched their outputs OFF within the 2.5–4.0 s acceptance window:
CH1 3.051 s, CH2 3.063 s, CH3 3.056 s. Each channel re-enabled with its
timer disabled and remained ON for 0.5 s. Before timer expiry, Keithley / KEL103
readings were CH1 1.00003 V, 0.0438347 A / 0.9976 V, 0.0452 A, 0.0450 W;
CH2 1.49428 V, 0.0673933 A / 1.4934 V, 0.0678 A, 0.1012 W; CH3
1.99735 V, 0.0904601 A / 2.0001 V, 0.0907 A, 0.1814 W. After expiry the
load readings fell to 0.0167 V, 0.0127 V and 0.0078 V respectively, with
zero measured current and power.

All 841 recorded `SYST:ERR?` replies were `0, "No error"`; the final
readback showed CH1–CH3 OFF, all timer states OFF and KEL103 INPUT OFF.
The operator confirmed final physical OFF. Output Recall was confirmed OFF
on the panel before the run but its AC power-cycle behavior was not tested;
therefore overall runner outcome remains **PARTIAL**, with Output Recall
HW UNVERIFIED. The earlier pre-power abort and its correction are documented
in [the first attempt report](2026-10-26T193545.109045Z_H06_qualification.md).
